connector.name: Vugola MCP
connector.registryDescription: Clip videos into captioned shorts, add captions & schedule posts - from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor.
connector.summary: Hosted at vugolaai.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package vugola-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vcoder25 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VUGOLA_API_KEY
env.description: Your Vugola API key (prefix vug_sk_). Get one at https://www.vugolaai.com/dashboard/api-key. Requires a paid Vugola plan.
